question: How do external and internal worship places differ in purpose and method?
premises: External places such as mountain tops serve particular accomplishments.
External places are not for liberation.
Internal equivalents within the body are practiced through application of the vital breath.
inference: External worship sites yield specific powers, while internal worship within the body is distinguished by breath-based practice and a different aim.
uncertainties: The verse states the purpose of external sites explicitly but leaves the liberative role of the internal practice implicit.
plain_english: Those external places are for particular accomplishments, not for liberation; the internal mountain-top and so on are within the body, practiced through the application of the vital breath.
